name: Harum
title: Father of Aharhel in the tribe of Judah
summary: Harum is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the father of Aharhel. He belongs to the tribe of Judah and is part of the genealogies compiled after the return from exile in Babylon. Little else is known about him beyond this genealogical reference.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Harum is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the father of Aharhel, as part of the genealogies of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of Judah's descendants
keyEvents.description: Harum is placed among the descendants of Judah who were recorded to preserve Israel's family history after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Aharhel's father
keyEvents.description: Harum's son Aharhel is mentioned as a man with families connected to the tribe of Judah, linking Harum to an important lineage.

keyEvents.title: The significance of the genealogies
keyEvents.description: The genealogies in 1 Chronicles, where Harum is mentioned, were compiled to confirm the identity and land rights of the tribes after the return from Babylon.
